body:
### Question

I am migrating a project to use `uv`.
One of the quirks (if you can call it that) of this project is that it has dependencies installed through git, and those repositories are private. Following what I believe to be the correct [documentation](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/authentication/git/#git-credential-helpers), I eventually got it to work, with a git credential helper configured.

But I had to configure the helper globally.
I would like to be able to configure this on the project level (with a `git config ...` instead of `git config --global`), to avoid the risk of this configuration affecting a unrelated project on the same machine.

Is this possible? Or have I followed the wrong path for what I want to do?

### Platform

Ubuntu 24.04 (on WSL)

### Version

0.12.5
title: Having a git credetials helper configured per-project (not globally) for `uv` to use
